description: This file contains utility classes and constants for interacting with Azure Table storage within the Orleans distributed application framework. It provides methods for error evaluation, table name validation, key sanitization, and query generation, as well as containing namespace definitions conditioned on compile-time flags.

classes.name: AzureTableConstants
classes.description: Contains constant values related to Azure Table storage such as default ETag, partition key, row key, and maximum batch size.

classes.name: AzureTableUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for handling Azure Table storage operations, error evaluations, query construction, and validation.

methods.name: TableStorageDataNotFound
methods.description: Determines if an exception indicates that the data being accessed does not exist in Azure Table storage.

methods.name: ExtractRestErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts REST error code from exceptions, specifically handling RequestFailedException.

methods.name: EvaluateException
methods.description: Examines an exception to extract and evaluate HTTP status code and REST error code, returning whether they were successfully retrieved.

methods.name: IsRetriableHttpError
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code and REST error code correspond to a transient or retriable error condition.

methods.name: IsContentionError
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP status code indicates a potential contention issue in storage operations.

methods.name: IsNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates a 'not found' error.

methods.name: ValidateTableName
methods.description: Validates whether a table name conforms to Azure naming rules.

methods.name: SanitizeTableProperty
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to remove or replace characters that are invalid for PartitionKey or RowKey values in Azure Tables.

methods.name: AnalyzeReadException
methods.description: Analyzes an exception encountered during a table read operation and determines if the error is retriable, logging details as appropriate.

methods.name: PrintStorageException
methods.description: Returns a detailed string description of a RequestFailedException.

methods.name: PointQuery
methods.description: Constructs a filter string for querying a single entity by PartitionKey and RowKey.

methods.name: RangeQuery
methods.description: Constructs a filter string for querying entities within a range of RowKeys in a specific PartitionKey.
